entities.summary: Hanno the Navigator was a Carthaginian explorer who lived during the fifth century BC, known for his naval expedition along the coast of West Africa. However, the only source of this voyage is a periplus translated into Greek. Hanno the Navigator was a explorers & navigators from Carthage (500 BCE, Carthage–500 BCE). Recognized as a landmark figure with global significance (referenced in 0 Wikipedia editions). Relevant to environmental history.
